scope.summary: Implement span/split columns as a paragraph-level attribute: a paragraph may span all or N columns of its frame or split into sub-columns, with before/after spacing and inside/outside gutter controls; applied through the paragraph style/override system (MT-170). Implement paragraph-level layout-flow attributes stored on paragraph style records and overrides (glyph rendering owned by 14.7): keep options (keep-with-previous, keep-with-next N lines, keep-lines-together all-or-start/end counts, start-paragraph anywhere/next-column/frame/page/odd/even), paragraph rules above/below (weight, type, color, tint, width, indents, offset), paragraph shading and borders (per-side widths, corner shapes, offsets, merge-consecutive, clip-to-frame, do-not-print), drop caps (line/character count, character style, scale-for-descenders), align-to-baseline-grid (all lines or first line only), and balance-ragged-lines. Composition executed by TextEngine (14.7).
acceptance_criteria: span/split columns + full paragraph layout-flow attribute set stored on styles/overrides and composed by TextEngine
proof_targets: span/split compose runtime; paragraph-flow-attribute composition test
expected_tests: live: span-all/span-N/split-N columns with spacing+gutter compose correctly
test: keep options, para rules above/below, shading/borders, drop caps, baseline-grid align, balance-ragged applied via paragraph style/override and executed by TextEngine

target_entries: Studio / Page Layout / Span columns & paragraph flow attributes

risk_if_missed: No spanning heads, keeps, rules, or drop caps; professional paragraph composition impossible.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
